title: Manufacturing and Selling Spurious Goods Causing Grievous Hurt

content.scenario: A pharmaceutical company in Delhi imported and sold spurious medicines that caused grievous hurt to several patients. The company's actions were found to be in violation of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.
content.outcome: The company may be punished with imprisonment for a term which may extend to seven years and with a fine which may extend to five lakh rupees, as per Section 91(1) of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

user_queries: What is the punishment for selling spurious medicines?
Can a company be imprisoned for causing grievous hurt to consumers?
What are the consequences of importing fake products?
